personality.description: This person tends to chase new ideas enthusiastically, experimenting with different approaches and staying open to unusual perspectives. They are often spontaneous and flexible in daily routines, but their loose structure can make them disorganized or prone to overlooking details and deadlines. In group discussions, they speak readily, bring energy to the conversation, and often spark momentum with lively, imaginative contributions. When faced with moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm, consider multiple viewpoints, and try to find a practical compromise, though they will firmly defend their own position if they believe strongly in it.
